summary: Iteration 7 tested: Trusted Contacts, SOS share link plus contacts, badge bonus when a trip is completed, ERP badge bonus settings, and the driver Earnings Wallet. Backend: all 11 new pytest tests pass. A light regression run (sos_dispatch, share_badges_livemap, tracking_ratings_invoice) gave 59 passed and 1 skipped. Frontend at 375x667, all requested flows pass: adding, validating and removing a contact; share-to-contact and share-trip-whatsapp open the correct wa.me URL with the /live/ link; share-add-contacts goes to the profile; the SOS sheet and status card, where sos-alert-contact-0 and sos-alert-family open the SOS message to the correct number; ERP settings save and the out-of-range error toast; all Wallet cards, chart, tabs and the earning rows with the bonus line. I fixed one blocker: the Row component dropped testID, so trusted-contact-{i} never rendered. No deprecated Expo packages found (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner and expo-background-fetch are absent).

minor.issue: today/week/month and the 14-day chart use UTC dates (core.now() is UTC; completed_at[:10] is a UTC date). Trips completed between 00:00 and 05:30 IST are counted on the previous day. Use Asia/Kolkata for date boundaries.
'paid' adds up every driver_payouts row whatever its status, while the driver wallet counts only PAID rows. Pending amounts in ERP and in the driver Wallet will differ if any payout is not PAID.
badge_bonus_top/gold accept a JSON boolean (true is saved as 1.0) because float(True) works. Minor.

ui_bugs.issue: Row did not pass testID to its View, so trusted-contact-{i} never rendered. FIXED by T1.

integration_issues.issue: Saving replaces the whole list using the cached `list`. If GET /me/contacts is still loading or has failed, the list is [] and saving a new contact deletes the existing ones on the server. The card also shows 0/5 with no loading or error state while loading. Turn off add until q.isSuccess and show loading and error states.

openWhatsApp calls window.open after waiting for the /share API call, so the tap is no longer a user gesture. iOS Safari and some mobile browsers may block the new tab. Native apps are not affected because they use Linking.
Number('') is 0, so a cleared number field (badge bonus, and also tax_rate and the others) is saved as 0 with no warning.

issues: The wallet-tab-trips and wallet-tab-payouts chips are 36px high, below the 44px touch-target minimum
Earning rows show the booking date while today/week buckets use completed_at, which can confuse drivers when the two differ

action_items: TrustedContacts: turn off add/remove until the contacts query has loaded, and show loading and error states so a save never wipes the saved contacts
driver/earnings: use IST (Asia/Kolkata) for the today, week, month and daily buckets
admin/payouts: count only PAID payouts in 'paid', or document why PENDING ones are included, so it matches the driver wallet

Optional: make the wallet tab chips at least 44px high; reject boolean and empty values for badge bonus settings; on web, open the WhatsApp tab during the tap itself (synchronously) to avoid popup blockers
critical_code_review_comments: Badge bonus is worked out only when the trip is completed, from the driver's badge at that moment. completion is idempotent because the IN_PROGRESS→COMPLETED transition can only happen once, so there is no double bonus
sos_routes.offer_wave_loop also seeds the badge bonus defaults at startup, which mixes unrelated work into one function; consider moving the seeding to the startup hook
The project has existing TypeScript errors (e.g. app/admin/bookings.tsx RefreshControl onRefresh types). Row's missing testID prop would have been caught by tsc

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 (pytest.ini sets xdist) and EXPO_BACKEND_URL taken from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env. For WhatsApp tests, stub window.open with add_init_script and read the URLs from window.__opened. The SOS confirm button can report 'outside viewport' while the sheet animates; use dispatch_event('click') or wait first.
